lead: Cinematic underwater film still, deep ocean, teal darkness, soft cyan bioluminescence.
notes: Mood-only mini images for abyssal_caretaker.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen abyssal_caretaker-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish abyssal_caretaker-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.
